<reason>CON won a competitive debate by keeping the motion’s “mainly” test live and winning the core causal clash: extra licensed hours add drinks on top of pre-loading, so the surge is larger and drunker, not merely relocated. PRO’s “same appetite in a safer room” story never overcame that, and treating CON’s timed exit pulse as a concession of the proposition overreached. CON answered Sydney, workers, and the walk-versus-drive bind more cleanly than PRO answered the extra-rounds / unbounded-night questions.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s R2/closing distinction between a last-train corridor timed to last call and a 2–4am entertainment grid, paired with the preload-plus-extra-doubles reply to PRO’s supervised-venue claim.</best_rebuttal>
